items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Carroll Dickerson's band. ... the last time I played with Carroll Dickerson was when we came here to New York in '29. We were at Conrey's Inn.

ctx.x: And then it says later led own band at the New Deal Club. Then again worked for Dickerson. In may 1935 began leading own sextet at the Three Deuces.
Well that's true. That's right. But I didn't go back with Carroll Dickerson.
